confirmatory_rule.name: confirm_rsi2_rsp_or_iwm_t0.005_d3
confirmatory_rule.definition: RSI(2)<5 on the replication instrument's cash session, and RSP daily return above SPY or IWM daily return above SPY. Enter 18:00 ET. Exit at +0.5% or at the close three sessions later.
confirmatory_rule.sample: USATECH 5-minute bid, test window 2022-01-01 through 2026-11-11. Round-trip cost is 0.02% of the entry price (about one SPX point when the index is 5000); 2x is 0.04%.

walk_forward: Parameters stay fixed. Train 2012-2017, validation 2018-2021, and test 2022-2026 are all stored. Nothing is refit.

availability.usa500_5m: Dukascopy bid from 2011-09-18. One-minute history for this span is not on disk. Window fills use the 5-minute open at the clock.
availability.usatech_5m: USATECH 5-minute bid, test window 2022-01-01 through 2026-11-11. Round-trip cost is 0.02% of the entry price (about one SPX point when the index is 5000); 2x is 0.04%.
availability.cpi: BLS schedule pages for 2012-2026. No 2011 dates. The 2025 pages omit the October reference-month CPI.
availability.fomc: Decision dates already listed in rare_setups_study.FOMC. Entry is 18:00 ET after the afternoon decision.
availability.holiday: A pre-holiday gap is four or more calendar days to the next cash session, so a normal weekend is not a holiday.

success_bar: Family cells need test win>=70%, win CI lower>50%, expectancy CI lower>0 at 1x and 2x, >=20 test trades, reality p<0.05 and DSR>=0.95 on the full matrix, and validation not entirely below zero. The confirmatory rule uses the same trade bar on its locked sample and a single-test reality check and DSR (N=1). The full-family DSR on that sample is reported beside it.
